c71_multifile_hashing_conventions.semantic_registry_fingerprint_source_exc:
def reference_catalog(self):
        return {"schema_version": 1, "revision": self.version,
                "lexicon_revision": self.lexicon.revision if self.lexicon else None,
                "lexicon_fingerprint": self.lexicon.fingerprint if self.lexicon else None,
                "alias_reviews_role": "historical_sidecar" if self.lexicon else "active_reviewed_sidecar",
                "sources": self.sources,
                "alias_reviews": self.alias_reviews,
                "ifc_mappings": self.ifc_mappings,
                "definitions": self.definitions,
                "ifc_fallback_a50": {"entity": "IfcBuiltElement", "predefined_type": "",
                                     "property_set": "", "status": "fallback_pending_review"},
                "uuid_contracts": {"lpg": "siti.transporte.gov.co + code",
                                   "kits": "siti.gov.co + SITI_CLASS_code"},
                "legacy_references": [
                    {**self._row(record), "review": self.review_assignment(record.code),
                     "legacy_ifc_mapping": self.transitions[record.code].get("legacy_ifc_mapping", {})}
                    for record in self.by_code.values() if not record.selectable]}
